mapper.insert: MERGE INTO EMP_ADDR dst USING (SELECT #{empno} AS EMPNO FROM DUAL) src ON (dst.EMPNO = src.EMPNO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ZIPCODE = #{zipcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDRESS = #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDR_DETAIL = #{addrDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMPNO, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, ADDR_DETAIL) VALUES (#{empno}, #{zipcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addrDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
